items.claim: Ramsey Brahim struggles in the clinch.
Neil Magny excels in the clinch.
items.quote: Neil Magny excels is he's really good in the clinch.

items.claim: Neil Magny has only lost to elite fighters in his recent losses.
items.quote: the only people he's come up short against in his last, let's say his last five losses... elite fighters.

items.claim: Neil Magny struggles on the mat.
items.quote: we've seen Neil Magny struggle on the mat in the past.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando is a very fast striker with a sharp left hook and snappy low kicks.
items.quote: Lucas Fernando, very fast striker. He's got a very sharp left hook. He's got very snappy low kicks

items.claim: Lucas Fernando uses knees to counter opponents crashing into range.
items.quote: if you try to crash past the long range weapons of Lucas Fernando, you're going to run into his knees.

items.claim: Raphael Tobias has big power and likes to load up on his punches.
items.quote: he's got very, very big power. He likes to sit down and load up on his punches.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando stands 6'3" with an 81.5-inch reach.
items.quote: this guy is 6'3 with an 81 and a half inch reach.

items.claim: Raphael Tobias is at a significant height and 7-inch reach disadvantage.
items.quote: Tobias is a 74 and a half inch reach, 6'2. So he's at a height disadvantage and he's at a significant reach disadvantage.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando is a former LFA light heavyweight champion who defended his belt.
items.quote: he was a champion in one of the most premier feeder leagues that lead to fighters getting into the UFC.

items.claim: Lucas Fernando is coming into the fight on a four-fight win streak.
items.quote: he's coming into this fight on a fouright win streak.

items.claim: Tafon Nchukwi (Tawn Gore) entered The Ultimate Fighter with only a 3-0 record.
items.quote: this is a guy he gets into into the Ultimate Fighter with just a three and0 record.

items.claim: Tafon Nchukwi has faced a strong strength of schedule in the UFC relative to his inexperience.
items.quote: anybody that he fights in the UFC, to me, it's a strong strength of schedule because of how inexperienced he is.

items.claim: Tafon Nchukwi's amateur career dates back to March 2013, giving him extensive training experience.
items.quote: His amateur career goes all the way back to March 8th of 2013 on Tapology... he's got a lot of experience with training
